expected_diagnosis: High CPU steal time suggests contention at hypervisor level.
recommended_next_checks: Correlate host telemetry and other VPS incidents.
resolution_guidance: Escalate to node team for workload redistribution/capacity.
verification: Steal time and user latency normalize.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
